```{r}
#| label: check-missing-sentinels

# check places where sentinels might be missing

missing_sentinels_pattern <- paste(
  "\\s[\\(\\[]",   # space before ( or [
  "[\\)\\]]\\s",   # space after ) or ]
  "\\s<i>",        # space before <i>
  "</i>\\s",       # space after </i>
  sep = "|"
)

test3 |>
  select(season, episode, type, speaker, transcript) |>
  # filter(type == "italics") |> 
  filter(str_detect(transcript, missing_sentinels_pattern)) |>
  # filter_out(str_detect(transcript, "</i>|[\\]\\)]$")) |> 
  collect() |> 
  gt()
```

```{r}
test4 |> 
  select(season, episode, type, speaker, speaker_note, transcript) |> 
  filter(season == 2, episode == 15) |> 
  # filter(type == "dialogue") |> 
  collect() |> 
  reclassify_type() |>
  peek_rows(transcript, condition = transcript == "", fmt = "t") |>
  mutate(
    speaker = if_else(
      when_all(
        type == "italics",
        lag(transcript) == ""
      ),
      lag(speaker),
      speaker
    ),
    speaker_note = if_else(
      when_all(
        type == "italics",
        lag(transcript) == ""
      ),
      lag(speaker_note),
      speaker_note
    ),
    type = if_else(
      when_all(
        type == "italics",
        lag(transcript) == ""
      ),
      "dialogue",
      type
    ),
    speaker = if_else(
      when_all(
        type == "description",
        lag(type) == "dialogue",
        lag(transcript) == ""
      ),
      lag(speaker),
      speaker
    ),
    speaker = if_else(
      when_all(
        type == "dialogue",
        is.na(speaker),
        lag(transcript, n = 2) == ""
      ),
      lag(speaker, n = 2),
      speaker
    ),
    speaker_note = if_else(
      when_all(
        type == "dialogue",
        is.na(speaker_note),
        lag(transcript, n = 2) == ""
      ),
      lag(speaker_note, n = 2),
      speaker_note
    )
  ) |>
  gt()
```

```{r}

blue_true <- function(tbl) {
  
  tbl |> 
    tab_style(
    style = list(cell_fill(color = "lightblue")),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = italicized_dialogue,
      rows = italicized_dialogue == TRUE
    )
  ) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_fill(color = "lightblue")),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = description_dialogue,
      rows = description_dialogue == TRUE
    )
  )
  
}

  peek_rows(transcript, "Things hard to get to", before = 10, after = 5) |>
```

```{r}
#| label: check-ms-names

# check pattern for recognizing multi-speaker speaker names separated by "and"

c(
  ms_name = "BISHOP and LOPEZ",
  ms_name = "NA'VI and THORSEN",
  ms_name = "WESLEY and DEL MONTE",
  dialogue = "BOLOs are out for Abril, and the DEA and FBI are launching",
  dialogue = "We need you and ... house while FBI and SWAT mobilize",
  dialogue = "BP and O2 are falling.",
  description = "(to NOLAN and CHEN)",
  description = "[LOPEZ and WESLEY leave the room]",
  unmarked_description = "LOPEZ and WEST are cruising",
  italics = "<i>OFFICERS ANGELA LOPEZ and TALIA BISHOP are coming down...</i>"
  
) |> 
  str_detect("^[A-Z\']+\\sand\\s[A-Z]+\\s?[A-Z]+$")

# ^[A-Z\']+\sand\s[A-Z]+\s?[A-Z]+
```

```{r}

multispeaker_lines <- test4 |> 
  select(season, episode, type, speaker, speaker_note, transcript) |>
  filter(type == "dialogue") |>
  # filter(str_detect(speaker, "[A-Z]{3,}\\sand\\s[A-Z]{3,}")) |> 
  filter(str_detect(speaker, ",|&|\\s(?i)and\\s|/")) |> 
  collect()

multispeaker_lines |> 
  mutate(
    speaker = speaker |> 
      replace_values(from = aliases$pattern, to = aliases$name),
    speaker = speaker |> 
      str_replace_all(",\\s", green_circle) |> 
      str_replace_all("/", green_circle) |> 
      str_replace_all("\\s?&\\s", green_circle) |> 
      str_replace_all("\\s?(?i)and\\s", green_circle) |> 
      str_remove_all("(?<=\U1f7e2)\U1f7e2")
  )

multispeaker_lines |> 
  clean_multispeaker_names() |>
  relocate(dialogue_type, .after = type) |> 
  separate_longer_delim(speaker, green_circle)

```
